comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Public production homebuilder selling homes to individual buyers with affiliated mortgage and title services; overlapping Sunbelt markets.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Large homebuilder with lot development plus mortgage and title services for homebuyers; same business model.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Single-family homebuilder with affiliated mortgage, title and insurance services, active in Southeast and Texas.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Pure lot developer selling to homebuilders, mostly D.R. Horton; no homebuilding, B2B only, and a different business.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Single-family homebuilder selling to first-time and move-up buyers, with affiliated mortgage and title services.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Production homebuilder with mortgage banking and title services for its buyers; same core business, though it uses an option-based lot model.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Life insurance, funeral, title and mortgage conglomerate; not a homebuilder, so its business is mainly insurance and financial.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Title insurance and settlement underwriter; it serves the real estate transaction market but doesn't build homes.
